nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: What gaps remain in the field of HIA that researchers and practitioners need to address?
nodes.answer: Researchers and practitioners need to assess predictive accuracy, increase case study examples, and support the institutionalisation of HIA.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Good health and well-being|Health policy and systems|Health technology assessment_qna_001
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: Who were the participants included in the survey for HIA research?
nodes.answer: The participants included HIA practitioners, academics, educators, commissioners, or anyone with relevant HIA experience (self-identified).

nodes.id: Subtopic:Social|Good health and well-being|Health policy and systems|Health technology assessment_qna_002
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What common methodology was identified among the studies regarding the evaluation of EHDs?
nodes.answer: The studies exhibited methodological challenges and lacked consistency, with seven studies using device-oriented functional units (FU) and others using treatment-oriented FU.
